ex.en: You must be at the station by 5 o'clock.
ex.zh: 你必須在五點前到車站。

ex.en: This shop is open from 9 to 6 o'clock.
ex.zh: 這家店從九點營業到六點。

ex.en: They planned to get together here at 7 o'clock.
ex.zh: 他們約好七點在這裡碰面。

ex.en: What is your occupation?
ex.zh: 你從事什麼工作？

ex.en: What's your occupation?
ex.zh: 您的職業是什麼？

ex.en: I like to do oil painting, but I don't intend to make that my lifelong occupation.
ex.zh: 我喜歡畫油畫，但不打算把它當成一輩子的職業。

ex.en: The building is ready for occupation next month.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓下個月就可以進駐了。

ex.en: The city was under military occupation for years.
ex.zh: 這座城市被軍隊佔領了好幾年。

occupant.zh: 居住者、使用者；（車內）乘客

ex.en: The previous occupant left the apartment very clean.
ex.zh: 前一位住戶把公寓留得很乾淨。

ex.en: All occupants must leave the building during the fire drill.
ex.zh: 消防演習時，所有人員都必須離開大樓。

ex.en: This is a daily occurrence.
ex.zh: 這種事每天都會發生。

ex.en: Power outages are a rare occurrence here.
ex.zh: 這裡很少停電。

ex.en: Delays are a common occurrence during rush hour.
ex.zh: 尖峰時段延誤是常有的事。

ex.en: I have occasional pains in the stomach.
ex.zh: 我的胃偶爾會痛。

ex.en: Even superheroes need an occasional break.
ex.zh: 就連超級英雄也需要偶爾休息一下。

ex.en: Today's weather is sunny with occasional clouds.
ex.zh: 今天天氣晴時多雲。

ex.en: When the big earthquake occurred, I was just ten.
ex.zh: 大地震發生時，我才十歲。

ex.en: Traffic accidents are likely to occur on rainy days.
ex.zh: 下雨天容易發生交通事故。

ex.en: Nobody knows when the earthquake will occur.
ex.zh: 沒有人知道地震何時會發生。

ex.en: A good idea occurred to me last night.
ex.zh: 我昨晚想到一個好點子。

ex.en: It never occurred to me that he was lying.
ex.zh: 我從沒想過他在說謊。

ex.en: Tom only wears a suit on special occasions.
ex.zh: 湯姆只在特殊場合穿西裝。

ex.en: On gift-giving occasions, people generally avoid giving money, but there are exceptions.
ex.zh: 在送禮的場合，人們通常避免送錢，但也有例外。

ex.en: This dress is perfect for any occasion.
ex.zh: 這件洋裝適合任何場合。

ex.en: I'd like to take this occasion to thank our team.
ex.zh: 我想藉這個機會感謝我們的團隊。

ex.en: On one occasion, he left his passport at the hotel.
ex.zh: 有一次，他把護照忘在飯店。

ex.en: Books occupy most of his room.
ex.zh: 書佔了他房間的大部分空間。

ex.en: The meeting room is occupied at the moment.
ex.zh: 會議室現在有人在用。

ex.en: The house is not occupied now.
ex.zh: 這間房子目前沒人住。

ex.en: The city was soon occupied by the soldiers.
ex.zh: 這座城市很快就被士兵佔領了。

ex.en: The armed forces occupied the entire territory.
ex.zh: 軍隊佔領了整個領土。

ex.en: She occupied herself with work all weekend.
ex.zh: 她整個週末都忙著工作。

ex.en: The game kept the kids occupied for hours.
ex.zh: 那個遊戲讓孩子們玩了好幾個小時。

ex.en: He likes going to the beach occasionally.
ex.zh: 他喜歡偶爾去海邊走走。

ex.en: Dick is occasionally late to school.
ex.zh: 迪克偶爾會上學遲到。

ex.en: He occasionally reads detective novels.
ex.zh: 他偶爾會看偵探小說。

ex.en: The Pacific is the largest ocean in the world.
ex.zh: 太平洋是世界上最大的海洋。

ex.en: There is sand at the bottom of the ocean.
ex.zh: 海底有沙子。

ex.en: He crossed the Pacific Ocean in thirty days.
ex.zh: 他花了 30 天橫渡太平洋。

ex.en: Hotel occupancy reached 90% during the holiday.
ex.zh: 連假期間飯店入住率達到九成。

ex.en: Office occupancy is still low after the pandemic.
ex.zh: 疫情過後，辦公室的使用率仍然偏低。

ex.en: The building is ready for occupancy.
ex.zh: 這棟大樓已經可以入住了。

ex.en: Maximum occupancy of this room is 50 people.
ex.zh: 這個房間最多容納 50 人。
